BiblicalUsage: Mutteh is a stretching out, a distortion — the iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is exceeding great, and the land is full of blood, and the city full of perverseness.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the stretched-out sin is the measure of the judgment: what is bent far enough breaks.
